content.name: Rebecca Adeyemi
content.title: Lead Digital Marketing Specialist
content.summary: Digital marketing specialist with 15 years across travel, agency PPC, furniture retail and insurance. Leads a five-person performance team at a regulated insurer, managing £2.4m in annual media and building the measurement setup that let the business cut aggregator dependence from 64% to 47% of new policies.

experience.title: Lead Digital Marketing Specialist
bullets: Lead a team of five covering paid search, paid social, SEO and CRO for a home and pet insurer, with a £2.4m annual media budget.
Grew direct online quotes by 41% in two years, reducing reliance on price comparison sites and saving an estimated £1.1m in commission.
Worked with compliance to build an FCA-approved ad copy library, cutting campaign sign-off time from ten days to three.
Introduced a geo-holdout testing method with the data team to measure the incremental effect of paid social, which led to a 30% budget reallocation.
Migrated tagging to server-side Google Tag Manager and Consent Mode v2, recovering conversion visibility lost to cookie consent.

experience.title: Senior Digital Marketing Specialist
bullets: Managed Google Shopping and Performance Max for 9,000 SKUs, growing online revenue from £14m to £23m over four years.
Rebuilt the product feed with custom labels for margin and stock depth so spend favoured profitable lines, raising return on ad spend from 5.2 to 7.4.
Led a site-speed and technical SEO programme with the developers that took organic sessions up 36%.
Hired and trained two PPC executives and wrote the team's first channel playbooks.

experience.title: PPC Manager
bullets: Ran paid search accounts for 16 agency clients in retail, education and B2B, with combined monthly spend of £600,000.
Retained the agency's largest client through a competitive pitch by presenting a revised bidding strategy and a 90-day test plan.
Wrote automated budget pacing scripts in Google Ads Scripts that saved account managers around eight hours a week.
Delivered monthly client reports and quarterly strategy reviews to marketing directors.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Executive
bullets: Managed email, affiliate and early paid search campaigns for coach and rail holiday packages.
Built segmented newsletters for over-60s and family audiences, lifting click-through rates from 2.1% to 3.8%.
Coordinated an affiliate programme with 40 travel publishers, contributing 12% of online bookings.

achievements.title: Lower aggregator dependence
achievements.detail: Direct channels' share of new policies rose from 36% to 53% in two years.

achievements.title: Industry speaker
achievements.detail: Spoke on incrementality testing at a Manchester digital marketing meetup in 2024.
